title: In 1947, architect John Lautner designed a Hollywood Hills home with a roof supported by a three-point steel structure; the preserved two-bedroom Polin House is now listed for $2.85 million
summary_full: Renowned architect John Lautner's striking house from 1947 has hit the market, offering a distinctive two-bedroom, two-bathroom experience in the vibrant Hollywood Hills. Spanning 1,342 square feet and priced at $2,850,000, this home features a groundbreaking steel roof truss design that provides an uninterrupted interior space. With outdoor terraces enhancing the living area, this listing is a rare chance to own a piece of architectural history.
